$comment: The local model the bench runs: InsustyPromptCoach's shipped SmolLM2-360M. Which models a ref ships, and its default, come from the ref (SLM_MODELS, DEFAULT_SLM_MODEL_ID); this file only describes them (sizes, priors, advertised languages). Sizes are the q8 ('model_quantized.onnx') files the extension loads on WASM, read from the Hugging Face API on 2026-09-26.

backend.runtime: onnxruntime-web (WASM) through @huggingface/transformers, the same runtime the extension ships

languages.summary: English-first. The card metadata lists only 'en' and states: 'SmolLM2 models primarily understand and generate content in English.'
